p.seg: If the cloud is like a rabbit mushroom
size, take a 12-liǎng carp eye to compare it.
If the cloud is like a wútóng seed size, take a 14-liǎng carp eye to compare it.
If the cloud is like a bullet size, take a 16-liǎng carp eye to compare it.
Fifteen white pearls as a standard is one bullet.
In general, in prescriptions that call for one yì to ten yì of water, each yì should weigh twelve liǎng.

When it says one liǎng, one fēn, and one zhū, use the modern silk floss scale accurately. Do not mistakenly use four zhū as one fēn, as this will definitely cause loss and harm the efficacy of the medicine.
In general, if it says powder, make powder; if it says pills, make pills; whether to boil with wine, or use vinegar, or cook with milk, follow the prescribed method exactly.
In general, when refining honey in a prescription, one jīn only yields twelve and a half liǎng, or one fēn; if the heat is too low or too high, it cannot be used.
When using fat in a medicinal paste, it must first be refined to remove the skin and membrane before it can be used.

In general, when preparing and processing various medicinal materials, be attentive and avoid mixing them up. Do not change the order by decocting before boiling, or boiling before decocting; follow the prescribed method exactly.

When preparing pills, use only honey if the recipe calls for honey, only maltose if the recipe calls for maltose, and only sugar if the recipe calls for sugar. Do not mix them, as this will surely cause diarrhea.
Jade and Stone Category, Highest Grade

Governs the body, the five zàng organs, and hundreds of diseases. Nourishes the spirit, calms the soul, benefits qì, brightens the eyes, kills spirits, evil influences, and ghosts. Prolonged use leads to spiritual enlightenment, immortality, and transformation into mercury.
(Above in red characters, from the Shénnóng Běncǎo Jīng)

Unblocks blood vessels, stops vexation and fullness, alleviates thirst, benefits the spirit, makes the face radiant, eliminates sudden abdominal pain, toxic qi, scabies, fistulas, and various sores, lightens the body, and leads to immortality.
(Above in black characters, recorded by Famous Physicians)

It is produced among the various barbarian tribes of Wǔlíng and Xīchuān, all belonging to Bā area, called Bā shā. Immortal classics also use Yuè shā, produced in Línjīn of Guǎngzhōu. Both places are good, but the bright and translucent ones are the best. Those resembling mica flakes are called mica cinnabar (yúnmǔ shā). Those resembling chūpū seeds (an ancient gambling piece) with purple quartz shape are called horse-tooth cinnabar (mǎchǐ shā), which is also good. Those resembling large and small beans or large round and smooth pieces are called bean cinnabar (dòu shā). Fine and broken pieces are called powder cinnabar (mò shā). These two kinds are coarse and not suitable for medicinal use, but only for painting.
【Quality】Bright and translucent, like mica that can be split, is good.

Dān Shā shēng Fúlíng Shān gǔ, jīn chū Chénzhōu, Yízhōu, Jiēzhōu, ér Chénzhōu zhě zuì shèng. Wèi zhī Chén Shā, shēng shēn shān shí yá jiān. Tǔ rén cǎi zhī, jué dì shù shí chǐ shǐ jiàn qí miáo, nǎi bái shí ěr, wèi zhī Zhū Shā chuáng. Shā shēng shí shàng, qí kuài dà zhě rú jī zǐ, xiǎo zhě rú shíliú zǐ, zhuàng ruò fúróng tóu, jiàn cù lián chuáng zhě, zǐ àn ruò tiě sè, ér guāngmíng yíngchè. Suì zhī zhǎn yán zuò qiángbì, yòu sì yúnmǔ piàn kě xī zhě, zhēn Chén Shā yě. Wú shí zhě mí jiā. Guò cǐ jiē táo tǔ shí zhōng dé zhī, fēi shēng yú shí chuáng zhě. (Cinnabar is produced in the valleys of Fulíng Mountain, and now comes from Chenzhou, Yizhou, and Jiezhou, but that from Chenzhou is the best. It is called Chen Sand and grows between the stone cliffs of deep mountains. The local people collect it, digging tens of feet into the ground before they see its shoots, which are actually white stones, called Cinnabar Beds. The sand grows on the stone, and the large pieces are like chicken eggs, and the small ones like pomegranate seeds, shaped like hibiscus heads. Arrowhead-shaped clusters connected to the bed are dark purple like iron in color, but bright and clear. Broken, they are jagged like walls, and those that are like mica sheets and can be split are true Chen Sand. The purer the sand, the better. Any sand acquired from washing soil and rocks beyond these descriptions is not considered grown on stone beds.)
【Qi】Its qi is thinner than its taste, yang within yin.
【Actions】Calms the heart and settles the soul.

When using, one must carefully identify, as there are hundreds of types. There is marvelous sulfur cinnabar (miào liú shā), as big as a fist or weighing one yì (a unit of weight), with fourteen mirror-like facets. If encountered on a cloudy or rainy day, red juice will ooze from the mirror surface. There is plum-cypress cinnabar (méi bǎi shā), the size of plums, which glows at night, illuminating a room. There is white courtyard cinnabar (bái tíng shā), the size of emperor zhu seeds (another name for Job's Tears), with small stars appearing on its surface. There is divine seat cinnabar (shén zuò shā), gold seat cinnabar (jīn zuò shā), and jade seat cinnabar (yù zuò shā), which prolong life without being processed in a alchemical stove. Then there are white gold cinnabar (bái jīn shā), clear water cinnabar (chéng shuǐ shā), yin-formed cinnabar (yīn chéng shā), Chén brocade cinnabar (chén jǐn shā), hibiscus cinnabar (fúróng shā), mirror surface cinnabar (jìngmiàn shā), arrow cluster cinnabar (jiàn cù shā), Cao powder cinnabar (cáo mò shā), soil cinnabar (tǔ shā), gold star cinnabar (jīn xīng shā), flat surface cinnabar (píngmiàn shā), and divine powder cinnabar (shén mò shā), which cannot be described in detail one by one. To process cinnabar, first in a quiet room, burn incense and purify oneself. Then take the cinnabar, bathe it in scented water, wipe it dry, and then crush and grind it. Then, in a bowl, grind it for three fu periods (a unit of time measurement in traditional Chinese medicine, representing hot season). Then, take an earthenware pot, place the ground cinnabar inside, and add licorice root (gāncǎo), purple-backed ardisia (zǐ bèi tiānkuí), and five-direction grass (wǔ fāng cǎo), each chopped, placing them above and below the cinnabar. Boil with east-flowing water for three fu periods as well. Do not let the water or fire be lacking. After the time is up, remove the three herbs, then wash it clean with east-flowing water and dry it in the sun. Then grind it again into powder. Store it in small porcelain bottles. Add half a liǎng each of green sesame grass (qīng zhī cǎo) and mountain beard grass (shān xū cǎo). Cover it and forge it over a ten-jin fire from sì (9-11 AM) to zi (11 PM-1 AM). Let it cool, then grind it again into powder. If you want to take it, mix it with honey and make pills the size of fine hemp seeds. Take one pill on an empty stomach. If adding to a regular medicine, grind it extremely finely and use it after water floating.
Calms the heart and treats corpse-borne diseases (shī zhù) and wind.
Moistens the heart and lungs, treats sores, scabies, and scabs. Can be taken internally or applied topically.

For cold damage, seasonal diseases, warm epidemics, headaches, high fever, and strong pulse, within one or two days, boil one liǎng in one shēng of water, drink it all at once, cover oneself with clothes and blankets to induce sweating, and it will be cured. Also treats infants under one month old who are frightened and seem to have wind-stroke and are about to die. Grind it thickly with freshly drawn water and apply the juice to the five hearts (palms and soles), and they will be cured immediately.
【Combined Treatment】Boil one liǎng in water for several boils, make it into powder, mix it with wine, and take it to treat pregnant women whose child has died in the womb and cannot be expelled.
【Adulteration】Realgar and orpiment from Wǔdū and Chóuchí mixed with orpiment are called cinnabar. Practitioners often use this as a fake.

Governs dead skin on the body, muscle, wind-stroke, cold and heat, as if on a vehicle or boat. Eliminates evil qi, calms the five viscera, benefits seminal essence, brightens the eyes. Long-term use lightens the body and prolongs life.
(The above in red text is from the Shénnóng Běncǎo Jīng)

Descends qi, firms muscles, mends fractures, supplements the center, treats five taxations and seven injuries, deficiency and depletion, shortness of breath, stops dysentery, beautifies the complexion, prevents aging, withstands cold and heat, high aspirations, and becomes a divine immortal.
(The above in black text is recorded by famous physicians)
